project.name: R1T topper Step 15 modular side insert rework
intent_sources: Studio decision 1320686: separate window inserts so window/cage/toolbox are interchangeable; window must be flat
Studio Step 15 charter and pinned lineage 4f9bef04

invariants.statement: The side window glazing is a separate planar removable part.
invariants.acceptance: CAD pane has constant side-Y faces and is labeled as a separate flat window insert.

invariants.statement: Window, cage, and toolbox variants use the same side-aperture interface.
invariants.acceptance: Exploded CAD proof shows all three variants sharing the same X/Z aperture profile, flange/seal land, and four retention centers.

invariants.statement: The low rounded shell, carbon bridge, closed rear hatch, and unobstructed top plane remain.
invariants.acceptance: Step 15 contract checks retain the rounded shell, positive bridge, closed two-pane hatch, and no top-center protrusion.

requirements.statement: Window insert pane thickness is constant and its mating face is planar.
requirements.acceptance: step15_checks.py verifies pane Y extent equals 8 mm for every side pane.

requirements.statement: Each side aperture has an explicit datum, 22 mm seal land, four-point retention pattern, and shell bridge.
requirements.acceptance: step15_checks.py verifies four interface packages, four fastener children per package, and positive bridge/shell intersection.

requirements.statement: WINDOW, CAGE, and TOOLBOX insert variants share the same outer profile and mating contract.
requirements.acceptance: The interchangeability proof and manifest contract are checked by step15_checks.py.

requirements.statement: Existing Step 15 visual locks remain intact while the side insert contract changes.
requirements.acceptance: The root set, shell volume, bridge width, rear hatch continuity, ports, and top-plane checks pass.

capabilities.process_family: parametric CAD solid modeling and STEP export
capabilities.source: repository skills/cad runtime and existing Step 15 exporter

components.name: continuous rounded carbon shell
components.function: outer A-surface and load path around apertures

rules: retain positive shell land around aperture

components.name: flat window insert
components.appearance: planar dark glazing against rounded shell

rules: reuse common profile and retention centers

components.name: toolbox insert
components.appearance: closed dark panel with service handle

rules: reuse common profile and retention centers

interfaces.geometry: rounded X/Z aperture datum, 22 mm perimeter flange/seal land, constant side-Y mating plane, four retention centers
interfaces.assembly: locate insert on datum, seat seal land, retain with four provisional fastener envelopes

work_packages.input: pinned Step 15 CAD lineage 4f9bef04 and decision 1320686
work_packages.output: native Step 15 STEP/GLB and review packet
work_packages.rework_boundary: reopen visual_review_step15.py and its contract checks

verification.method: operator visual review of ordered CAD evidence and interchangeability proof
deterministic source-derived CAD contract checks and mutation tests
